summary: Four local defects are demonstrated: optional roll aggregation, README head size, overlapping direction template and exchanged baseline totals. No demonstrated central-result damage. Actual training normalization and evaluation reconciliation remain unresolved.
limitations: No author code, training, weights, datasets or paid APIs executed.

Later V2 project noted from README but not independently reviewed; no exhaustive errata search.
